protocol.title: Inference Integrity / v1
protocol.quality_method: Case-sensitive exact match against all 1000 reference answers; no filtering.
protocol.timing_scope: End-to-end wall-clock latency per request including preprocessing, model inference, and postprocessing. Report median in microseconds.
